subject: Request: Exec authorization for >20% Hosted API concession for TrialBio strategic pilot
messages:
From: Sarah Kline <sarah.kline@trialbio.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Barbara Liu <barbara@trialbio.com>, procurement@trialbio.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API pricing question — pilot scale

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency and cost profile look promising. We're preparing an internal business case for a 12-month strategic pilot (expected steady-state ~4M tokens/mo, month 1 ramp to 10M). Our procurement lead asked whether Redwood can provide a deeper introductory rate — ideally in the 25–30% off list ballpark — to make the P&L for the pilot work while we validate clinical throughput.

I attached a month-by-month usage forecast. Can you confirm whether this is something you can approve, or if you need to escalate? We have a tight procurement window (signed PO by Dec 10).

Best,
Sarah

Attachments: TrialBio_Month1_usage_forecast.csv
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing question — pilot scale (need deal desk input)

Ben / Laura — forwarding TrialBio's ask. They're a high-fit strategic trial customer (clinical workflows, potential APAC expansion next year). Forecast attached shows steep ramp to 10M tokens in month 1 and 4M tokens steady-state.

They explicitly asked for 25–30% off list. Our standard hosted promotional band tops out at 20% without exec signoff. Can Deal Desk or Finance advise whether we can approve a 28% introductory concession with a 12-month commit and a clear usage SLAs/fallbacks?

Key points to include in the escalation:
- Forecast: aggressive ramp month 1 (attachment)
- Strategic value: potential multi-region pilot + reference case for healthcare vertical
- Our ask: exec signoff for 28% off list for 12 months, then revert to published tiered rates

Please advise next steps — they want PO by Dec 10.

Thanks,
Karthik

Attachments: TrialBio_Month1_usage_forecast.csv, Contract_Summary_v3.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 14:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing question — pilot scale (pricing analysis)

Karthik / Laura — I ran the preliminary numbers. Short summary:

- Baseline list revenue (12m): $XXXk (confidential) based on forecast.
- 28% concession would reduce gross billed revenue by ~28%, but with the ramp and expected retention probability the unit economics are still borderline-positive if we can secure usage protections.
- Risks: extreme first-month burst could blow past our reserved capacity assumptions unless we gate initial throughput; also public healthcare references require privacy/contract addendums (TrialBio requested data residency clarifications).

Recommendation: escalate to exec for approval with the following controls:
1) 12-month term with minimum monthly committed usage (commit floors at 3.5M tokens/mo after month 1).
2) Auto-reversion to published pricing at month 13.
3) Inclusion of a usage throttling beacon we control in the first 30 days to protect capacity and limit burst costs.
4) One-time onboarding credit limited to $Xk (to be negotiated) not part of the concession calculation.

If Finance (Mina) and Revenue Ops (Markus) sign off on controls, we should request exec sanction for the 28% concession.

-Ben
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing question — pilot scale (finance sign-off request)

Team — I reviewed the economics and the proposed guardrails. Finance is comfortable escalating to the GL if the following are documented in the contract:

- Committed minimums (3.5M tokens/mo after month 1).
- Clear termination language tied to non-payment or usage anomalies.
- Audit right to verify usage reporting quarterly.

I'm adding Aditya for exec clearance — this is above our 20% delegated concession band. If Aditya can greenlight the 28% with the controls above, Finance will prepare the accounting entries and margin carve-outs.

-Mina
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing question — pilot scale (exec decision request)

Karthik / Ben / Mina —

Appreciate the analysis and controls. Given TrialBio's strategic fit (healthcare reference, multi-region potential, clear ramp), I approve a one-time 28% concession on Hosted API list for a 12-month commitment subject to the terms Mina called out. Conditions:

1) Commit floor at 3.5M tokens/mo after month 1 (explicit schedule in SOW).
2) Throttling control for first 30 days and an agreed ramp plan; go/no-go checkpoint at Day 45 tied to usage and SLA compliance.
3) Finance to approve the discount accounting and reporting.
4) Legal to add the minimum audit and termination clauses.

Ben — please confirm you will (a) update the contract summary, (b) produce a redlined SOW including the throttle and commit schedule, and (c) send an approval email back to TrialBio with the updated terms.

Aditya
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kline <sarah.kline@trialbio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing question — pilot scale (approved with conditions)

Sarah —

Good news: our execs have approved a one-time 28% concession for a 12-month Hosted API commitment. A few conditions to finalize the PO:

- Minimum monthly commit: 3.5M tokens/month after month 1 (we understand month 1 has a ramp spike).
- Throttling/controlled ramp in the first 30 days; a Day 45 go/no-go checkpoint.
- Audit and termination clauses as discussed; finance will need quarterly usage reports.
- The concession applies to hosted API list rates and will auto-revert at month 13.

Ben will share a redlined SOW and an updated contract summary today. If that aligns we can accept a PO by Dec 10 and aim for a Jan 4 production readiness target.

Thanks for the partnership — excited to get TrialBio onboarded.

Cheers,
Karthik

Attachments: pricing_comparison_hostedapi.xlsx, Contract_Summary_v3.pdf
